title_zh: 中美公布“百日计划”初步成果
title_en: U.S. and China Announce Initial Results of the 100-Day Action Plan
summary_zh: 中美公布特朗普与习近平海湖庄园会晤后启动的“百日计划”初步成果。美国商务部长罗斯、财政部长姆努钦与中国副总理汪洋参与相关磋商。成果涉及美国牛肉对华出口、中国熟制禽肉对美出口议题、生物技术产品审查、液化天然气和金融服务等；其中牛肉进口承诺设有后续实施期限。
summary_en: The United States and China announced initial results of the “100-Day Action Plan” launched after the Trump–Xi summit at Mar-a-Lago. The consultations involved U.S. Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross, Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin, and Chinese Vice Premier Wang Yang. Topics included U.S. beef exports to China, Chinese cooked-poultry exports to the United States, biotechnology reviews, liquefied natural gas, and financial services.

sources.name_en: U.S. Department of Commerce joint release
